about_the_game:
Experience the cult hit that doesn't quit, Dr. Radiaki is here to tickle your funny bone until it really hurts. An unapologetic sense of fun and non-stop action meets in an unforgettably bizarre adventure!

The scheming Dr. Radiaki is going to destroy the entire world! For profit! And assorted evil reasons too! Need I say more? The doctor is horribly disfigured, totally twisted, and has a whole host of minions to do his bidding. Only you, special agent Mack Banner can finally rid the world of this menace! Also, I don't think anyone else wanted the job but that's beside the point.

It isn't just that 'The Fortress of Dr. Radiaki' was one of the first games to pioneer a "unique" flavor of mouse control, or that its character renders are both classic and iconic. This game is a shooter where it counts. That's right, count 7 different weapons such as the baseball bat, samurai sword, pistol, machine gun, grenade launcher, flamethrower and an fashionable energy weapon. Trust me, you're going to need 'em.

How do you even prepare for this situation? Imagine 15 varieties of enemies, everything from stealthy ninja warriors, mutated alligators, robots with toasters for heads and giant babies in lederhosen, for some reason. This isn't just about being skilled in combat, it is psychological warfare of the highest caliber!

Navigate the fortress through 15 intense levels, each filled to the brim with fist pumping action and majestic, maze-like corridors. You might think you are ready, but that is just what Dr. Radiaki wants you to think!

The rats are very cool.
detailed_description:
The Improvements of Dr. Radiaki

We've added some features to elevate what is already an exercise in FPS excellence. These can be individually disabled.

  • THERE IS NOW STRAFING

  • Non-nausea inducing mouselook

    • You no longer need to hold down the left mouse button to move the camera.

    • Yes. Really.

  • Fully rebindable controls

    • Presets for both original and modernized control schemes

    • Left mouse is actually Fire now. And WASD are used for movement. Groundbreaking stuff.

  • Native support for the most common controllers

    • Fully compatible with the DK Bongos

  • Togglable sprinting

  • More reasonable default settings, for improved graphical fidelity and gameplay

  • Native Linux build, fully playable on Steam Deck!

  • Save scum across devices with the power of Steam Cloud
